extracted.name: Nankhatai Recipe | Eggless Nankhatai | Indian cookies | Mouth melting Crunchy Nankhatai
extracted.description: Nankhatai are traditional indian cookies made with all-purpose flour, Semolina, Sugar and ghee. and It’s crunch, light and crumbly. The nankhatai made in numerous ways. Recipe link - youtu.be/ZkMHhdimi0k
instruction_lines: In a bowl sieve together flour, besan and sooji. Add salt and mix till well combined.
Add 1/2 cup ghee and cardmom powder and make soft dough. Knead the dough very softly.
Grease parchment paper with ghee and put in the baking tray.
Make medium size ball and give any design you like. (I just pressed finger in the middle and put almond on top)
Remove nankhatai from oven and let cool completely.
Store in an airtight container and enjoy!
